districts.name: Patri Line
districts.character: Railway strip along the north edge: the station, a parked mail coach, lodges and sack godowns under pale yellow bulbs.
districts.gameplay_role: Leans chor. One bending foot lane and the godown roofs; the jeep only touches it at the station. A place to bank loot and regroup.

districts.name: Afsar Colony
districts.character: Walled bungalows on straight tube-lit lanes, a ruined haveli in the north-east corner and the bus stand half-way down.
districts.gameplay_role: Leans police: long lit lanes and few hiding spots. Chors slip through by the hedge path and between the parked buses.

districts.name: Machhi Ghat
districts.character: Stone river steps below a retaining wall: fish market, ice-house, a small temple, upturned boats and a jetty, lit by green lanterns.
districts.gameplay_role: Mixed. Police on Gol Road can only come down through five gaps in the wall, so they cannot drop straight onto the jetty.

districts.name: Karkhana Basti
districts.character: The old mill and its chimney in the north half. In the south, tin-roof huts on zigzag lanes that end at a scrapyard. Orange sodium light.
districts.gameplay_role: Strongly chor in the south, where lanes bend every few steps and police take longest to arrive. But tin roofs are loud, and this corner is the farthest from every jackpot.

districts.name: Sarafa Bazaar
districts.character: Shuttered shop-houses with touching flat roofs, the old stone gate Tota Darwaza, and a dark back lane under tarpaulins.
districts.gameplay_role: Leans chor and holds the jeweller. The roofs work as a second street. Police only get clean views on the roads that edge it.

districts.name: Andhera Bagh
districts.character: A walled, unlit park with four gates, bushes and one lamp-lit footpath. The Timtim Talkies cinema glows on its north edge.
districts.gameplay_role: The stealth pocket: a chor can cross the middle of town unseen. Fair for police because there are only four gates and the lit path splits the park in two.

districts.name: Kotwali Chowk
districts.character: The bright centre: clock tower, police station and lock-up, the court and bank to the north, vegetable-market sheds to the south. A dry drain runs through it.
districts.gameplay_role: Police home ground, with two jackpots and the lock-up. Chors survive on its hidden lines: the drain bed, the lodge roofs and the bending back lanes.

rob_locations.name: Chamakchand Sarraf
rob_locations.notes: Front shutter is loud from the first second. The roof hatch at the back is slower but silent until it opens, and leads straight onto the rooftops.

rob_locations.name: Bachat Bank
rob_locations.notes: The jackpot nearest the police station, so it has the shortest hold. Its back door is next to a crawl pipe under the ring road.

rob_locations.name: Mandi Tijori Ghar
rob_locations.notes: Tucked behind the vegetable-market sheds. The back hatch opens into the dry drain, which runs to the river.

rob_locations.name: Timtim Talkies
rob_locations.notes: The dare job: on the lit main road, seconds from the police station. Only sensible while police are busy elsewhere.

rob_locations.name: Tankhwah Daftar
rob_locations.notes: On a kink of the mill lane, a short run from the goods siding.

rob_locations.name: Bus Adda Booking
rob_locations.notes: Among the parked buses, about the same distance from two ways out.

rob_locations.name: Dak Dibba
rob_locations.notes: Its strongbox is only open from 3:00 to 4:00. Both teams know when and where, so it is a planned showdown.

rob_locations.name: Ghanta Paan Bhandar
rob_locations.notes: The bait: so close to the police station that its ping pulls a guard away just before a jailbreak.

rob_locations.name: Chhotu Halwai
rob_locations.notes: A warm-up grab on the way to the jeweller.

rob_locations.name: Chudi Gali Kirana
rob_locations.notes: Just outside the ring, a short run from the goods siding.

rob_locations.name: Vakil ka Bangla
rob_locations.notes: A porch on a straight, lit lane near the ruined haveli.

rob_locations.name: Machhi Bazaar
rob_locations.notes: The quickest small job to bank in the south, so police check it early.

rob_locations.name: Ration Dukaan
rob_locations.notes: Deep in the tin-roof lanes. Police take almost a minute to get here, which is why it only pays small.

rob_locations.name: Baraf Khana
rob_locations.notes: On the west river steps. Pairs well with the cinema through the park, and gives chors a reason to visit the south-west.

police_sites.name: Kotwali Thana
police_sites.notes: Walled yard beside the clock tower. All police start here and count to 15 while the chors scatter. The lock-up cage is in its north-west corner, with doors onto two different lanes.

police_sites.name: Karkhana Naka
police_sites.notes: Booth where Lambi Sadak meets Gol Road on the west side. Watches the seam between the mill and the tin-roof lanes, and the park’s west gate.

police_sites.name: Haveli Naka
police_sites.notes: Booth on the east side of Gol Road, about 10 seconds on foot from the bank. Chors can see it from the crawl-pipe exit before they step out.

police_sites.name: Ghat Chowki
police_sites.notes: Booth at the Station Road gap in the ghat wall. Watches the park’s south gate and the way down to the river.

escape_points.name: Maal Gaadi Siding
escape_points.how_it_works: North-west. Throw the loot into an open goods wagon. Reached along Signal Lane or down the roof ladder; the last few steps are open ground under a lamp.

escape_points.name: Khandhar Haveli
escape_points.how_it_works: North-east. Stash in the courtyard of a ruined mansion. Enter by the lit front porch, or through the broken back wall where the hedge path ends.

escape_points.name: Machhi Ghat ki Naav
escape_points.how_it_works: South-east. Drop the loot into a fishing boat. Reach it along the open jetty, or by a hidden ledge from the mouth of the drain.

escape_points.name: Kabadi Godown
escape_points.how_it_works: South-west. Sell to the scrap dealer. The safest way out, but the farthest from every jackpot, and the tin roofs above it are loud.

special_routes.name: Ganda Nala Bed
special_routes.notes: A dry drain one level below the street, from the station to the river. It passes under Gol Road twice where nobody on the road can see in. A grate under the main-road bridge forces a dash across Lambi Sadak. Both teams can use its six ramps.

special_routes.name: Tota Darwaza Chhat
special_routes.notes: From the jeweller’s roof hatch, over the top of the old gate, then along godown roofs to a ladder beside the goods siding. The only way to cross the ring road above the jeep.

special_routes.name: Tirpal Surang
special_routes.notes: A dark, narrow back lane under tarpaulins from Gol Road to Station Road, with three side doors. Its east mouth faces one of the lock-up levers.

special_routes.name: Lodge Chhat Line
special_routes.notes: The jailbreak line from the north: station stairs, a footbridge over Gol Road, lodge roofs, then a ladder that lands beside the lock-up.

special_routes.name: Baad Surang
special_routes.notes: A storm pipe behind the bank, for chors only: 7 seconds out of sight, then a look through the grate before stepping out. A hedge path carries on to the ruined haveli.

special_routes.name: Tin Chhat Daud
special_routes.notes: A culvert from the park to the tin-roof lanes, then a run across the hut roofs to the scrapyard. Quick, but everyone nearby hears feet on tin.
